prompts.debug_stick: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new production pixel-art locomotion sprite sheet for EXACTLY the orange rabbit Hoppy and cyan DEBUG STICK in the reference sheet. Reference is for character identity, palette, chunky pixel density and dark outline only. Black short-sleeve shirt, cream muzzle and tail, two long orange ears, orange legs, no trousers or armor. Both paws visibly grip the same short cyan baton with navy handle and gold collar in EVERY pose. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 16 complete isolated sprites with large clean transparent gutters, same body proportions and scale. No labels, borders, ground, shadow, motion lines or detached effects. Read strictly row-major: cells 1-6 are SIX DISTINCT sequential SIDE-VIEW RUN poses facing RIGHT: 1 left foot forward heel contact and right foot far back; 2 down weight absorbing left leg, right knee folding; 3 passing right knee high and left foot under hip; 4 opposite right foot forward contact with left foot far back; 5 down on right leg with left knee folding; 6 passing left knee high. Exaggerate alternating orange feet, open stride and bent knees, not six near-identical shuffles; ears trail and torso bobs subtly, baton steady at waist. Cells 7-10 are FOUR distinct WALK AWAY poses, rabbit's BACK faces camera: black shirt back and cream tail fully visible, ears symmetrical, face NOT visible, both paws grip baton across front beyond body with baton end visible on right; alternating feet and soles. Cells 11-14 are FOUR distinct WALK TOWARD camera poses: FRONT face with two eyes, cream muzzle centered, both paws on baton across waist; alternating foreshortened left and right forward feet. Cells 15-16 are front and back neutral carry poses. Every sprite fits fully inside its own quarter cell. Authentic crisp 16-bit pixel art compatible with reference, no illustration smoothing. Frame geometry must show real leg animation.
